title: Love the UX & UI
body: Love how simple the app is and useful, but I hope the free version has more than ONLY 3 habits to add.

title: Love this app
body:
This app really helped me, and I love the way of checking-in with (3D Touch).

But I wish there another option in the frequency other then the days : Sunday ,Monday ,etc.

Frequency like : every two days, or every 10 days for example.

title: Perfect
body:
I have just one complain.
The smart widget sometimes are unable to be loaded. Therefore, I'm forced to restart my phone.
Your application has become an essential part of my daily life. Really thank you so much and wish you the best of luck ❤️

title: You me of the best
body:
I liked this app because it's visual. You can place a giant image for each habit or tasks to motivate you. 

More mover, you can add cards for each habit for more details. 

I encourage everyone to have a look any try this app. 

Thanks for the developer and their smart work.
